decisions.decision: Release B has no approved method to obtain audio from captionless third-party YouTube videos. Release A must not download audio or enter STT.
decisions.deadlineRule: Before M3 starts, whichever is earlier
decisions.releaseImpact: Blocks Release B only; requires Release A STT/audio counters to remain zero.
unblockConditions: A named legal owner signs a dated policy memo for one non-circumventing audio acquisition path.
The memo states allowed videos, retention, deletion, geography and audit requirements.
D2-B and D3-B independently pass after D1; D1 alone does not enable STT.

decisions.decision: D2-A freezes YouTube Data API v3 videos.list for metadata preflight and OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17 for translation, but no approved caption-text provider exists for arbitrary public videos. The official captions.download method requires permission to edit the video. Release A provider execution remains NO-GO. D2-B STT remains OPEN/NO-GO.
decisions.releaseImpact: Blocks Release A M1 real-provider path and all Release B STT work; does not block caption-only synthetic contract fixtures.
unblockConditions: PO and legal approve one documented caption-text source for non-owner public videos without scraping, IP rotation or source-control bypass.
Uhura records a successful authorized caption retrieval against at least one corpus video and a denied-path test without audio/STT fallback.
R2D2 demonstrates provider metering rejects a job before spend exceeds USD 0.15.
Any provider/model/prompt/schema change bumps pipelineVersion and invalidates prior cache evidence.

decisions.decision: D3-A has a 20-video Release A candidate manifest, two assigned Traditional-Chinese review roles, a five-point rubric, a 4/5 acceptability threshold, deterministic sampling and replacement rules. Zero videos are promoted to verified because official preflight, caption-text retrieval and staging do not exist. D3-B STT corpus remains OPEN and separate.
decisions.deadlineRule: Before Release A quality/latency claims or M1 gate pass
decisions.releaseImpact: Blocks Release A quality, latency and success-rate claims; blocks Release B independently through D3-B.
unblockConditions: All 20 candidates pass official preflight within 24 hours of the test run.
The approved caption provider retrieves usable English sentence timing for all 20 without audio or STT.
The named Release A staging environment exists and records the frozen provider/model/pipeline fingerprint.
Both reviewers independently score 10 deterministic segments per video and at least 90% of all 400 ratings are 4 or 5.

decisions.decision: Freeze the PRD initial anonymous quota at 5 parse requests per installation per rolling 24 hours, 20 per IP per rolling 24 hours and one in-flight job per installation.
decisions.releaseImpact: Product value is frozen for Release A; runtime enforcement and abuse evidence remain NOT RUN and block M2 launch.
unblockConditions: R2D2 provides clock-controlled quota, Retry-After and zero-downstream-call evidence.
PO reviews real abuse/cost data before changing the frozen values.

decisions.decision: Raw audio deletion within 24 hours and successful LearningDocument cache retention for 7 days are frozen values, but no store, purge job, deletion log or runtime proof exists.
decisions.releaseImpact: Blocks Release A M2 launch evidence, not contract readback; raw audio remains unreachable while D1/D2-B are NO-GO.
unblockConditions: Backend store and daily purge job exist.
Clock-controlled tests and deletion logs prove both TTLs without content logging.
QA independently reruns purge and expiry probes.

decisions.decision: The 15-minute limit applies to the first Release A and Release B corpora. Every current Release A candidate has a YouTube-page-observed duration at or below 646 seconds; any failing or longer replacement is rejected rather than widening the limit.
decisions.releaseImpact: PASS for the product boundary and observed candidate durations; official videos.list recheck is still required by D3-A before quality execution.

releaseAConfig.pipelineVersionActivationRule: Reserved and immutable for this decision package, but MUST NOT be deployed until captionTextProvider.status is approved. A provider, model snapshot, prompt, schema or segmentation change requires a new version.

caption.source: English creator-provided or YouTube automatic captions on a supported public video

captionTextProvider.reason: YouTube Data API v3 captions.download requires permission to edit the video, so it is not an approved arbitrary-public-video caption provider.

providerCost.scope: Direct per-task provider usage only; excludes fixed infrastructure. YouTube quota units are reported separately and are not assigned an invented USD value.
providerCost.llmWorstCaseFormula: 2 attempts * ((12000 input / 1000000 * USD 0.75) + (12000 output / 1000000 * USD 4.50)) * 1.10 maximum documented regional uplift
providerCost.enforcement: Reject before a provider call that could make estimated direct provider spend exceed the hard cap; return non-retryable cost_limit_exceeded. Runtime metering is NOT RUN.

youtubeQuota.limitation: Quota values do not establish caption download authorization or a USD cost.

releaseARedLines.captionUnavailableBehavior: 422 captions_unavailable; no job, audio, STT or LLM

unblockConditions: D1 has a dated legal decision for a compliant audio acquisition path.
One STT provider, model/version, timeout, cost ceiling, retention and deletion policy are separately approved.
A separate Release B implementation and corpus gate passes; this cell never enables Release A audio or STT.
D2-B.releaseImpact: Release B remains OPEN/NO-GO; no Release A audio, transcribing, STT or transcriptSource=stt path is enabled.

unblockConditions: Create and approve a separate captionless corpus and reviewer protocol after D1 and D2-B pass.
Prove the Release B corpus, audio retention, STT output and quality evidence in its own gate.
Keep the Release A 20-video caption-only denominator unchanged and never mix corpora.
D3-B.releaseImpact: Release B quality and launch remain OPEN/NO-GO; Release A D3-A stays caption-only with verifiedCount=0.
